caseName: Central Railroad v. Director, Division of Tax Appeals of the Department of the Treasury
caseNameFull: Central Railroad Co. of New Jersey v. Director, Division of Tax Appeals of the Department of the Treasury
attorneys: James D. Carpenter and Judson C. McLester, Jr. for appellant., Theodore D. Parsons, Attorney General of New Jersey, and Bejamin C. Van Tine, Deputy Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question.

The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice Jackson, and Mr. Justice Burton are of the opinion .that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
